_what: proposed visuals for the DCI-1 v7 paper, with the exact data each needs
_evidence_base: six development-rehearsal lanes; the registered v7 study has zero confirmatory rows

specs.title: Delta_R forest
specs.claim: On no model and in no outcome position does A cost B more than same-form difficulty-matched companions by the registered generic-load threshold; L3c is licensed in every cell.
specs.filter: lane_role == 'canonical'  (use all 12 rows only in the appendix)
specs.uncertainty: simultaneous 95% (sim_lower/sim_upper, F1 studentised max-modulus); marginal 95% as inner tick (marg_lower/marg_upper)
required_annotations: shade attainable_min..attainable_max, or mark rows where l3c_bounded_by_arm_level is True
caption must say development rehearsal, not confirmatory
direction column: A_COMPARATIVELY_BETTER is a named §28.1 outcome, not an absence
specs.why_figure: twelve intervals sitting in a narrow band far from +0.10 is a shape, not a set of numbers

specs.title: Loss decomposition: raw solo-to-composed loss vs matched-reference loss
specs.claim: The solo-to-composed loss is large and model/position dependent and is almost entirely generic: matched companions produce the same loss or more.
specs.visual: dumbbell/slope: D(B<-A) and D(B<-Rbar) joined, Delta_R annotated as the gap
specs.uncertainty: simultaneous 95% on D_B_from_A and Delta_R ONLY. D(B<-Rbar) is a derived mean of three F2 members and has NO registered interval - draw as bare tick and state it.
required_annotations: state that Delta_R = D(B<-A) - D(B<-Rbar) exactly
negative D is a resolved delivery GAIN, not a null
specs.why_figure: the estimand is the difference between the two plotted quantities

specs.title: Direction x outcome position
specs.claim: Which instruction pays, and how much, depends on direction and on position; Lambda reverses sign on gemma-3n-e4b-it.
required_annotations: mark outcome_position == 'second' rows POSITION_CONFOUNDED (v5 §11.4)
a negative D(B<-A) is a resolved delivery gain; emit_l1 not firing is not a null
specs.why_figure: the sign reversal across positions is a visual fact

specs.title: Order contrasts (F11)
specs.claim: The quantity depends on the position of the outcome constraint, by the registered contrast.
required_annotations: Ord_CL is NOT_IDENTIFIED on both Qwen lanes: show as absent, never as zero
an interval containing zero is NOT order-invariance unless §17.3's equivalence rule and precision precondition are met
Ord_Lambda = Ord_B - Ord_A exactly; the dependence is declared
specs.why_figure: five members x four models is compact as a plot and unreadable as prose

specs.title: Primary numerical results
specs.filter: family in ('F1','F11') and status == 'IDENTIFIED' and lane_role == 'canonical'
specs.why_table: exact values are the deliverable; the figures carry the shape
specs.companion: full 810-row estimands_master.csv in the appendix / supplement

specs.title: Per-reference Delta_j
specs.claim: Delta_R averages over real between-reference heterogeneity.
specs.why_appendix: F2 is a secondary family and cannot change a primary conclusion (v5 §23)
required_annotations: join to references_selected.csv so each j is labelled with its instance (e.g. MK2:1)

specs.title: Same-form vs broad-class
specs.claim: One Tier-3 budget companion behaved very differently from the same-form pool.
specs.uncertainty: simultaneous 95% - NOTE two DIFFERENT families (F1 for Delta_R, F10 for Delta_broad); say so
specs.MISLEADING_IF: presented in the main paper as a difficulty-matched form-versus-class contrast
required_annotations: COMPANION_CLASS_NOT_MATCHED is registered and attaches to every Delta_broad statement

POST-HOC: the broad-class companion was NOT difficulty-matched on the registered coordinate. |iota_CL - iota_A| on the confirmatory data is 0.213-0.816, against §13.10's 0.15 caliper. On gemma-3n-e4b-it the companion's solo compliance (0.789) is BELOW its own chance rate (0.807).
cause: the §13.11 chance column was 0.0 on every replication (CHANGES_SCIENTIFIC.md 2026-08-29)

specs.title: Reference-matching diagnostics
specs.claim: The three core references were matched to iota_A inside the registered caliper; the broad-class companion was not.
specs.visual: dot plot on the iota axis
specs.marks: iota_A as a vertical rule; R1,R2,R3,CL as points; +/-0.10 caliper as a shaded band; a second differently-styled point per companion for the POST-HOC confirmatory iota
specs.uncertainty: none on the calibration iota (§13.8 selects on the point estimate); two-split equivalence interval available in iota_split_diff_lower/upper
specs.why_figure: this is the picture that makes the chance-column defect visible

specs.title: Candidate attrition through V(R)
specs.claim: The candidate pool is lost mostly at raw headroom and two-split stability, not at the difficulty caliper.
specs.why_figure: the ordering is lexicographic and the point is where the pool is lost

specs.title: Calibration curves for n* and m*
specs.claim: n* and m* were selected prospectively from solo compliance curves under registered bands.
specs.marks: points shaded by `eligible`; `selected` ringed; band_lower..band_upper as a horizontal band; `aim` as a rule; load_zero_chance_compliance as a dashed line on the B panel (what §34 D17's construct floor reads)
specs.uncertainty: none recorded per rung; state '192 topics, 4 draws, point estimates'
required_annotations: gemma-3n-e2b-it selected n* = 8 at the grid top: OPERATING_POINT_AT_GRID_BOUNDARY

specs.title: Robustness: vacuity-forced and graded recodings
specs.claim: Delta_R's L3c reading survives both registered recodings on every lane.
specs.visual: three marks per model x position (primary, vacuity_forced, graded_0.99) plus a second panel of F6 differences
specs.uncertainty: simultaneous 95% (F5 for the recodings, F6 for the vacuity differences)

threshold_meaning.0.05: F6 gate on the vacuity difference (§17.4)

required_annotations: qwen3-4b-instruct-2507 FAILS the F6 gate: vac(B|B+R2)-vac(B solo) = +0.147 [+0.117,+0.177] first, +0.061 [+0.039,+0.082] second
on that lane Delta_R goes +0.006 [-0.015,+0.028] -> -0.048 [-0.079,-0.018] under the vacuity-forced recoding: L3c holds under both, the DIRECTION does not
F6 is exactly 0 with a degenerate bootstrap on all three Gemma lanes

specs.title: Coverage C1-C8 on two bases
specs.claim: The spectrum arm was lost by a registered design-time rule, not by an outcome.
required_annotations: C4 is the only decisive condition lost, and only on the calibration basis, on all six lanes
under v7 A7 that costs the spectrum arm only; the core arm is retained

specs.title: Per-block heterogeneity in Delta_R
specs.claim: The block-mean Delta_R summarises a wide per-topic distribution.
specs.visual: histogram or beeswarm per model x position, with the block mean and its interval overlaid
specs.uncertainty: the registered block-bootstrap interval ONLY, taken from fig1_delta_r_forest.csv
specs.MISLEADING_IF: drawn as a smooth density, or if any interval is computed from the per-block spread
required_annotations: per-block Delta_R lives on a coarse lattice (multiples of 1/24 at M=8 with three references): use lattice-aligned bins
display only; no inference from this table

specs.title: Projection audit
specs.claim: §13.6's pre-composition projection is compared against the realised composed compliance.
specs.visual: projected vs realised scatter with the +/-0.05 allowance band
required_annotations: POST-HOC. §13.6's projection is an ADMISSION quantity; this record licenses no claim and revises no admission
largest miss: r5/gemma-3n-e2b-it pair:B+A@outcome_first, projected 0.618 vs realised 0.340

specs.title: What the design could not identify
specs.claim: 21 registered members are NOT_IDENTIFIED on every lane; none of them is a null result.
required_annotations: single registered cause: §12.6 condition C4 lost on the calibration basis (spectrum arm) and C8 (near-form arm)
NEVER render these as zero

specs.title: Repeat-lane agreement
specs.claim: Re-running §12-§13 from scratch on the same model moves Delta_R by less than the realised half-width.
specs.uncertainty: each lane's own half-width, shown as a reference span
specs.MISLEADING_IF: presented as two independent replications, or as test-retest reliability
required_annotations: the two roots selected DIFFERENT reference severities (qwen3-4b MK1:6 vs MK1:7; gemma-3n-e2b-it MK2:1/MK1:4/MK5:7 vs MK2:7/MK1:1/MK5:8) and iota_A itself moved
so the difference is selection PLUS sampling variability

rejected_candidates.reason: v5 §6.1 cross-replication firewall: no cross-model scalar carries a claim and no cross-model multiplicity family exists. Facet, never pool.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Delta_R vs iota scatter / fitted difficulty-response line
rejected_candidates.reason: delta_difficulty, beta and alpha_f are NOT_IDENTIFIED on every lane (spectrum arm never generated). A line through three same-difficulty references is the collapsed construct v5 §11.8 warns about.
the near-form arm qualified on no lane (C8 unmet everywhere).
v5 §17.3: L3c says the upper bound is below 0.10, not that Delta_R = 0. Five of twelve cells actively exclude zero on the NEGATIVE side.
v5 §11.5 registers them; no v7 module computes them and the execution-path audit lists no producer.

rejected_candidates.candidate: main-paper same-form vs broad-class at 'matched difficulty'
rejected_candidates.reason: the broad-class companion was not difficulty-matched on the registered coordinate (see A2).
